result.reason: The redline adds contractors, retains affiliate coverage, and provides the fallback M&A-successor transfer right. However, it does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable or limit termination of subscription licences to uncured material breach, so it does not reach the full playbook position. Making the assignment carve-out mutual is unnecessary and may alter counterparty risk. The wording also awkwardly permits either party to assign “the licence granted hereunder,” although only Sparkling is the licensee.
